title: U-Chrom Atlas
description: Single-cell and spatial 3-D genome datasets in the ChromData format (.chromdata.zarr): contact maps, structures, compartments, RNA and images, read over HTTP on demand.

studies.title: Integrative spatial profiling of 3D genome organization and gene expression in tissue
studies.summary: Hi-C and RNA from the same spots of tissue sections: mouse brain, mouse embryos at E11.5 and E13.5, and human melanoma.

studies.title: Spatially resolved chromatin architectures in mammalian brain tissues

studies.title: Spatially resolved genome architecture in mouse embryonic development

studies.title: Linking genome structures to functions by simultaneous single-cell Hi-C and RNA-seq

studies.title: 3D structures of individual mammalian genomes studied by single-cell Hi-C

studies.title: Cell-cycle dynamics of chromosomal organization at single-cell resolution

studies.title: GAGE-seq concurrently profiles multiscale 3D genome organization and gene expression in single cells

studies.title: Droplet Hi-C enables scalable, single-cell profiling of chromatin architecture in heterogeneous tissues

studies.title: Droplet-based high-throughput 3D genome structure mapping of single cells with simultaneous transcriptomics

studies.title: Identification of multiple genomic alterations and prediction of neoantigens from circulating tumor cells at the single-cell level

studies.title: Spatial multi-omics reveals cell-type-specific nuclear compartments

studies.title: Genome-scale imaging of the 3D organization and transcriptional activity of chromatin

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C-RNA: mouse brain
datasets.name: Mouse brain
datasets.description: Two sections; Hi-C, RNA and a tissue image from the same spots. Per-spot 1-Mb contact maps (reprocessed by U-Chrom from the deposited read pairs), bulk maps, the authors' single-spot A/B, cell types and CellCharter clusters.

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C-RNA: mouse embryo (E11.5, E13.5)
datasets.name: Mouse embryo, E11.5 and E13.5
datasets.description: E11.5 and two E13.5 replicates. Per-spot and bulk contact maps for the spots inside the published tissue mask, RNA, images, cell types.

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C-RNA: human melanoma
datasets.name: Human melanoma
datasets.description: Two sections. Per-spot and bulk contact maps, RNA, images, 28 cell types and CellCharter clusters. The single-spot A/B scores are not included (their bin layout is not given).

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C: E13 embryo (50 µm)
datasets.name: Mouse embryo, E13 · 50 µm
datasets.description: Spatial Hi-C and RNA sections; per-spot maps (the authors' and reprocessed ones), bulk maps, single-spot A/B, images.
datasets.paper: Chen, Guo et al. 2026, Nature Methods

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C: embryonic brain E14.5 to E18.5 (10 µm)
datasets.name: Embryonic brain, E14.5–E18.5 · 10 µm
datasets.description: Three Hi-C and three RNA sections. Per-spot and bulk contact maps reprocessed by U-Chrom, single-spot A/B, RNA, images.
datasets.paper: Chen, Guo et al. 2026, Nature Methods

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C: embryonic brain E14.5 to E18.5 (20 µm)
datasets.name: Embryonic brain, E14.5–E18.5 · 20 µm
datasets.description: Three Hi-C and three RNA sections. Per-spot and bulk contact maps reprocessed by U-Chrom, single-spot A/B, RNA, images.
datasets.paper: Chen, Guo et al. 2026, Nature Methods

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C: adult cortex (10 µm)
datasets.name: Adult cortex · 10 µm
datasets.description: One Hi-C and one RNA section. Per-spot and bulk contact maps reprocessed by U-Chrom, single-spot A/B, RNA, images.
datasets.paper: Chen, Guo et al. 2026, Nature Methods

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C: adult hippocampus (10 µm)
datasets.name: Adult hippocampus · 10 µm
datasets.description: One Hi-C and one RNA section. Per-spot and bulk contact maps reprocessed by U-Chrom, single-spot A/B, RNA, images.
datasets.paper: Chen, Guo et al. 2026, Nature Methods

datasets.title: Spatial Hi-C: adult cerebellum (20 µm), without contact maps
datasets.name: Adult cerebellum · 20 µm
datasets.description: Two Hi-C and two RNA sections with the authors' single-spot A/B, RNA and images. Contact maps are not included: the barcode-to-spot pairing of this chip is not resolved.
datasets.paper: Chen, Guo et al. 2026, Nature Methods

datasets.title: Spatial ATAC-Hi-C: mouse brain
datasets.name: Mouse brain
datasets.description: Two sections with chromatin accessibility and Hi-C from the same spots: per-spot and bulk contact maps, per-spot ATAC signal, images.
datasets.paper: Wang P. et al. 2026, Nature Methods

datasets.title: SpaceA: E13.5 embryo, section C6
datasets.name: Mouse embryo, E13.5 · section C6

figure.caption: Section C6, spots by contact cluster

datasets.description: 4,974 spots of a 50 × 100 grid; SPRITE clusters of each spot (1.41 million; 206,000 after the authors' filter) as multi-way contacts, per-spot 1-Mb maps of their fragment pairs, a pooled map, a contact embedding and clusters. Sequencing run 1 of 3 only (about 3 % of the section's reads); to be replaced with all runs.

datasets.title: Single-cell Hi-C and 3-D structures: haploid mouse ES cells
datasets.name: Haploid mouse ES cells
datasets.description: Eight cells, each with its contact pairs and the authors' ten structure models at 100 kb (model 1 as the coordinates, models 2-10 as layers); per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: Dip-C and 3-D structures: adult mouse cortex
datasets.name: Adult mouse cortex · 510 cells
datasets.description: 510 cells of the adult cortex (P56, P309, P347) with at least 100,000 contacts: contacts binned at 5 kb per cell and the authors' first Dip-C structure of each cell (20 kb particles, one trace per chromosome copy); the authors' cell types; a Hi-C embedding of the cells (scHiCluster, 1 Mb).

datasets.title: Single-cell Hi-C: diploid mouse ES cells
datasets.name: Diploid mouse ES cells (serum) · 1,175 cells
datasets.description: 1,175 cells (batches 1CDS1 and 1CDS2): the authors' fend-pair contacts lifted to mm10 and binned at 10 kb per cell; the GEO features (cell-cycle group, QC, contacts); a Hi-C embedding of the cells (scHiCluster, 1 Mb). Contact maps only: both homologs are mixed, so no structures.

datasets.title: HiRES: adult mouse brain
datasets.name: Adult mouse brain
datasets.description: 399 cells with contacts, RNA and the authors' diploid 3-D genome structure (20 kb, shown at 200 kb); seven cell types; per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: HiRES: mouse embryo, E7.0 to E9.5
datasets.name: Mouse embryo, E7.0-E9.5
datasets.description: 7,469 cells from E7.0 to E9.5 with contacts, RNA and the authors' diploid 3-D structure of every cell (20 kb, shown at 200 kb); stages, 21 cell types, cell-cycle phases; per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: dscHi-C: aging mouse cortex
datasets.name: Mouse cortex, 3, 12 and 23 months
datasets.description: 32,777 cells of the mouse cortex at 3, 12 and 23 months of age, about 66,000 contacts per cell; seven cell types and their subtypes; per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: GAGE-seq: mouse cortex
datasets.name: Mouse cortex
datasets.description: 3,296 cells with contacts (about 220,000 per cell) and RNA of the same cell; 29 cell types; per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: GAGE-seq: human bone marrow CD34+
datasets.name: Human bone marrow CD34+
datasets.description: 1,445 haematopoietic progenitor cells with contacts (about 210,000 per cell) and RNA of the same cell; 10 cell types; per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: Droplet Hi-C: mouse cortex
datasets.name: Mouse cortex, Droplet Hi-C
datasets.description: 6,235 cells, about 33,000 contacts per cell (cis pairs of at least 1 kb and trans); 20 cell types; per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: Paired Hi-C: mouse cortex, contacts and RNA
datasets.name: Mouse cortex, Paired Hi-C (with RNA)
datasets.description: 24,284 nuclei with contacts (about 2,200 per nucleus, cis of at least 1 kb and trans) and RNA of the same nucleus; 17 cell types; per-cell and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: scHiCAR: mouse frontal cortex, contacts, accessibility and RNA
datasets.name: Mouse frontal cortex
datasets.description: 5,313 cells with contacts (about 20,600 per cell), chromatin accessibility (about 30,000 fragments per cell) and RNA of the same cell; 22 cell types; per-cell, per-cell-type and merged contact maps.

datasets.title: Uni-C: human cell lines and circulating tumour cells
datasets.name: Human cell lines and circulating tumour cells
datasets.tissue: GM12878, COLO320-DM, PDX circulating tumour cells
datasets.description: 23 deeply sequenced single cells: GM12878 (10), COLO320-DM (6) and circulating tumour cells of a pancreatic cancer PDX mouse (7); about 9 M unique contacts per cell (4-26 M); per-cell maps at 100 kb and 1 Mb; per sample the merged cells and a bulk library.

datasets.title: Uni-C: mouse circulating tumour cells and MC38
datasets.name: Mouse circulating tumour cells and MC38
datasets.description: 20 deeply sequenced single cells: circulating tumour cells of two KPC mice (6 + 6) and the MC38 line (8); about 6 M unique contacts per cell (2-10 M); per-cell maps at 100 kb and 1 Mb; per sample the merged cells, and the MC38 bulk libraries.

datasets.title: DNA seqFISH+: adult mouse cerebellum
datasets.name: Adult mouse cerebellum, three fields of view
datasets.description: 1,799 cells of three fields of view; chromosome copies traced in 3-D genome-wide (100,049 targeted loci, about 6,000 detected per cell) with 62 immunofluorescence and RNA signals per locus; six cell types.

datasets.title: Chromatin tracing: chr21 in human cell lines
datasets.name: IMR90, K562, A549, HCT116 ± auxin · chr21
datasets.description: 56,376 chromosome 21 copies traced at 30 kb: 28-30 Mb in IMR90 (also by cell-cycle stage), K562, A549 and HCT116 RAD21-AID with or without auxin; 34.6-37.1 Mb in HCT116 with or without auxin; 18.6-20.6 Mb in IMR90. Ten 4DN sets; the set and its description per cell.
datasets.license: see the 4DN Data Portal (cite the 4DN papers, acknowledge the lab)

datasets.title: ORCA: Drosophila bithorax complex
datasets.name: Drosophila embryos · BX-C
datasets.description: 167,107 traces of the bithorax complex (2, 3 and 10 kb steps over 130-700 kb) in wild-type and mutant embryos, with mRNA and nascent RNA counts of the same cells, embryo and tissue ids. Seven 4DN sets.
datasets.license: see the 4DN Data Portal (cite the 4DN papers, acknowledge the lab)

datasets.title: ORCA: mouse ES cells, chr3 and chr6
datasets.name: Mouse ES cells · CTCF / cohesin degrons

figure.caption: One 3-Mb locus of chr3, ES cell

datasets.description: 107,929 traces in 98,714 cells: chromosomes 3 and 6 at 150 Mb (about 1-Mb steps) and 3-Mb loci (30 kb steps), CTCF-AID and RAD21-AID with or without auxin; Geminin and nuclear size per cell. 32 4DN sets. Coordinates are local to each trace's image crop, so the traces overlap in an overview.
datasets.license: see the 4DN Data Portal (cite the 4DN papers, acknowledge the lab)
